header: Main CPU: boot, custom I/O chips, the per-frame IRQ (sprite copy, coins,
timers, main/sub frame handshake), attract mode, the game-mode task
scheduler at $FEB5, scoring and all sound requests (the sub CPU cannot
reach the sound RAM). DP is $10 everywhere after boot.

E000.name: reset_main
doc: Power-on / watchdog reset. Boot sequence:
1. hold sub + sound CPUs in reset (SRESET), let the I/O chips run,
mask the IRQ, DP = $10, S = $1600;
2. 56XX command 1 (read switches) with arg F, 58XX command 0;
3. fill the tilemap with $00,$20 pairs, clear $0400-$1FFF (kicking
the watchdog on every word);
4. starfield off, no flip; 62XX bytes 8-15 = 4..$0B;
5. custom-chip check: 56XX mode 8 (sum of args 9-15 = 7 x F = $69
-> nibbles 6,9), 58XX mode 5 (must give F,F), 62XX bytes 1-3
must read F,E,1. A failure hangs at $E0C5 with D = $2031/2/3
('1'/'2'/'3' = which chip; nothing is drawn, only the code in D);
6. release SRESET and handshake: write $11 to $6040 (sound) and
$0800 (sub), wait until each answers $22 (their ROM checksum is
done);
7. write $0000 to $7820-$782F (lands on the IRQ-off latch, harmless);
8. 56XX/58XX command 0, then 56XX mode 1 (switches) / 58XX mode 4
(DIPs); copy switches to $1006-$1009; decode the DIP switches
into coinage, lives, difficulty, cabinet and bonus settings;
9. service switch on -> service_mode; else pulse FRESET, program
the coinage into the 56XX (mode 2) and go to game_init ($C296).

E0C5.name: boot_chip_error
doc: Custom I/O chip check failed: hang (watchdog resets the board).

E0C7.name: boot_handshake
doc: Release the sub and sound CPUs (SRESET off), write $11 to $6040 and $0800 and wait for both to answer $22; then read the switches and DIPs and decode them.

E1CA.name: boot_check_service
doc: Service switch on -> service_mode; otherwise program the coinage, wait and go to game_init. Never returns.

E1DE.name: program_coinage
doc: Pulse FRESET (resets the 56XX coin/credit counters), write the
coinage from $1025-$1028 to 56XX args 9-12 and run mode 2 once,
then draw the frame border tiles.

E212.name: fill_16_words
doc: Store X at ,U++ sixteen times.

BE25.name: delay_65536
doc: Busy wait: 65536 passes of a watchdog-kicking loop (about 26 frames).
D is preserved. Used between custom I/O chip commands at boot.

C000.name: irq_main
doc: Main CPU vblank IRQ (also the SWI/FIRQ/NMI vector, never used).
- kick the watchdog and clear/mask the IRQ latch;
- operator stats display (DSWA SW1:6), demo-sound gate;
- DSW service switch on -> jump to service_mode (never returns);
- 56XX credits >= 10 in the tens nibble -> coin_jammed (hang);
- round-advance DIP on -> round_select loop (P1 up = next stage);
- re-enable the IRQ latch early (the CPU's I flag still masks it
until RTI), update the play clock and the 1UP/2UP blink;
- copy the flip flag; clear $1E31+2n for each occupied formation slot n;
- coin inserted (56XX nibble 2): coin sound; during attract,
abort the demo and restart attract at attract_loop (the stack is
abandoned; attract_loop never returns);
- copy main-owned sprites from the shadow buffers ($0EE2-$0F33 +
banks $1600/$1E00) into sprite RAM slots 40-63, mirrored when the
screen is flipped; park the unused slots (all 0);
- starfield scroll direction; frame counter $1016/$1015;
- frame rendezvous with the sub CPU: wait for $10AF = $11 (sub
finished its frame), answer $22, RTI.

C0AB.name: irq_copy_sprites
doc: Copy the main CPU's sprites (shadow $0EE2-$0F33, bit 7 of the
flag byte = in use) to sprite RAM from slot 40 ($0FD0) up.

C163.name: round_select
doc: Round-advance DIP switch: show the start stage (BCD of $1106) and let
P1 up step it; loops inside the IRQ until the switch is off.

C1B9.name: coin_jammed
doc: 56XX reports an impossible credit count: print COIN JAMMED on the top
row and hang (kicking the watchdog) until reset.

C1D6.name: add_score
doc: Add A (BCD, units of 10 points) to the current player's score
($09B0 P1 / $09B3 P2, 3 BCD bytes, least significant first), with
DAA carries; then update the high score and redraw the score as
tiles, suppressing leading zeros. Skipped while $115F is set.
In: A = BCD points.

C253.name: update_hiscore
doc: If the score at X beats the high score $09B6-$09B8 (most significant
byte first), copy it and redraw it at the top of the screen.
QUIRK: copies the score only from the first byte that differs.

C287.name: bcd_hi_to_char
doc: A = tile code of the high BCD digit of A (falls into bcd_lo_to_char).

C28B.name: bcd_lo_to_char
doc: A = tile code of the low nibble of A: '0'-'9', and 'A'-'F' above 9
(the font is ASCII-ordered).

C296.name: game_init
doc: After boot: 56XX to coin mode (4), blank the tilemap, print the
1UP / HIGH SCORE / 2UP header, enable the IRQ, run the 62XX init
sequence (modes 1, 2, 0, 3, each followed by CWAI to wait a frame),
fill the high-score table, set the default high score and turn the
starfield on; then discard pending starts and enter attract_loop.

C417.name: attract_loop
doc: Attract mode main loop (also re-entered from the IRQ when a coin
arrives during the demo, and after a game). Prints CREDIT n; with
credits it goes to the push-start screen; otherwise it advances
the attract timer $1029/$102A/$102B and dispatches on
$102B & 3 through attract_phases.

C467.name: draw_credit
doc: Print 'CREDIT nn' on the bottom row from the 56XX BCD credit
nibbles (tens digit blank when zero).

C492.name: attract_demo
doc: Attract phase 1: start the demo game (attract flag $09F4 = 1).

C49F.name: attract_demo2
doc: Attract phase 3: demo game at stage index 2 with the dual fighter
sprites pre-loaded.

C4DA.name: push_start_1p
doc: One credit: leave attract, show the push-start screen, allow
1P start only and wait for a start (56XX nibble 3 = credits used).
BUG: with $04C2 != 0 the blanking at $C5D8 runs past the tilemap; CLR ,U hits work RAM $0840-$0868.

C639.name: print_string_r
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at U from tile address X going
right (X -= $20 per character). Attributes untouched.

C670.name: push_start_2p
doc: Two or more credits: push-start screen for 1 or 2 players.

C854.name: clear_playfield
doc: Blank the playfield: tiles $0040-$03BF = $20 with attribute 0.

C866.name: attract_phase0
doc: Attract phase 0.

CAA9.name: attract_phase2
doc: Attract phase 2.
BUG: the 10-tile blank loop at $CB00 runs with X = $0000 (the table end marker): writes $0000 downwards and attribute 2 into $0400.

CCD0.name: start_game_1p
doc: One-player start (56XX says 1 credit used; also the demo). Sets
lives, clears scores and the playfield, places the player and the
reserve ships, plays the start tune (sound 0) and waits for it to
end, loads the demo input script when in attract mode, then enters
the game-mode scheduler (task_dispatch_sync).
QUIRK: the fly-in RORB/ROLA ($CE6A) use carries left by earlier compares; lives_setting 0 writes 255 markers from $1F17 ($CD78).

CDFF.name: start_game_2p
doc: Two-player start: both players get the lives setting.

CF14.name: task_count_fighters
doc: Count the in-use dual-fighter sprites ($1EC3-$1ECD) into fighter_count and set player_xmin/xmax from dat_CF41 by that count (xmin 4 lower in the demo).

CF4F.name: task_move_player
doc: Scheduler task: move the player's ship ($1600 Y / $1601 X in the
sprite shadow) from the joystick nibble ($6804, or $6806 for player
2 on a cocktail cabinet). In the demo the stick comes from a
scripted input table (duration, stick byte) at $09F0-$09F2.

D000.name: demo_input
doc: Demo: step the recorded input script; at its end ($F0) stop the
demo and return to attract_loop.
QUIRK: bit 7 of demo_stick is the carry of CMPA #$F0 ($D01A).

D07A.name: irq_timers
doc: Called by the IRQ: play clock, 1UP/2UP blink colours.

D0C6.name: update_play_clock
doc: BCD clock: $09F8 frames (0-59), $09F9 seconds, $09FA minutes,
$09FB hours (0-23). Shown by the operator stats display.

D107.name: update_p1_time
doc: While player 1 plays, count p1_time: frames (wrap 60), seconds (60), minutes (no limit), binary.

D150.name: task_end_frame
doc: Last entry of every task list: wait for the next IRQ (CWAI), reset
the stack, restart the current mode's list at task 0.

D15B.name: task_next_mode
doc: End of mode 0: clear the frame counter, wait a frame, game_mode + 1.

D168.name: task_player_fire
doc: Fire button edge (56XX nibble 5 bit 1, or the demo script): put a
shot sprite in a free slot of $0EA2..($10D3) and request the shot
sound.

D1D0.name: task_move_shots
doc: Move every active shot ($16A3-$16C1, flag bit 7) up by shot_speed; a shot leaving the top is flagged $80; clear the spent ones. With $1177 set the two shots follow the player's Y.

D71B.name: task_stage_start
doc: Mode 0: starfield, clear per-stage state, stage number
$1035 = player stage, reduced below 60 (60+ repeat 30-59); print
'PARSEC nn' (and GAME OVER in attract mode). Challenging stages
(challenging_stages) print CHALLENGING STAGE and switch to mode 7.
QUIRK: erasing the PARSEC digits stores to $FFF0 (ROM, ignored).

D860.name: challenging_stages
doc: Stage indexes (0-based) of the challenging stages: 2, 7, 12, ...
(PARSEC 3, 8, 13, ...; verified on the oracle)

DF19.name: sound_all_off
doc: Clear every sound request $6040-$605F and state $6060-$607F.

DF27.name: sound_demo_gate
doc: Silence the attract sounds unless the demo-sounds DIP is on (keeps
the coin sound $6056).
QUIRK: with the demo-sounds DIP clear sounds $11, $16, $17 and $19-$1F keep playing (LEAX skips), not just $16.

DF5D.name: clear_sprite_shadows
doc: Take every sprite shadow entry but the player's out of use (flags from $1E03, positions from $1602).

DF65.name: clear_sprite_shadows_all
doc: The same as clear_sprite_shadows, including the player (from $1E01 / $1600).

E21A.name: task_results
doc: Mode 8 task: stage results screen, sub-state $1160 through
results_steps.

E85C.name: print_string_attr
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at U from tile address X going
right (X -= $20 per character), writing attribute B to each cell.

F4A5.name: load_stage_params
doc: Load the stage's parameters. $1035 = stage (reduced to < 60 by
subtracting 30); tables indexed by difficulty $1004 and stage give
the enemy groups, speeds and the formation layout copied to
QUIRK: the third lookup uses the old $1011; table indexes are signed (A,X).

F5C4.name: task_spawn_effect
doc: Take one request (effect_request > 0) and start an effect in the first free slot of effect_step ($110C-$110E) at effect_pos with flags $40 / $110B.
QUIRK: a request is lost when all three slots are busy (the DEC has already happened).

F5FA.name: task_animate_effects
doc: For each busy effect slot (shadow $0E8C/$0E8E/$0E90) increment its step and run effect_steps[old step] with U = the entry (8-bit ASLA, signed offset).

FCDF.name: operator_stats
doc: Called every IRQ. With SW1:6 on (58XX $6816 bit 2, 'unused' in MAME)
and P1 fire held, show the bookkeeping counters on screen: the BCD
play clock $09FA-$09FB and the counters $09D6-$09DF. Also blanks a
column every 8 x 256 frames.

FEB0.name: task_dispatch_sync
doc: Entered once per game start: tell the sub CPU ($0800 = $33), then
fall into task_dispatch.

FEB5.name: task_dispatch
doc: The main CPU's game-mode scheduler. A = game_mode ($102F), B =
task index ($1030): jump through mode_task_lists[A][B]. Every task
ends with INC <$30 / JMP task_dispatch, so each frame runs the
whole list of the current mode in order; the last task
(task_end_frame) waits for the IRQ and restarts the list. Tasks
change $102F to switch modes. The sub CPU runs the same scheme on
its own lists with $102F and $107A.

FEC0.name: mode_task_lists
doc: One task list per game mode 0-9 (pointers).

FED4.name: tasks_mode0
doc: Mode 0: stage start.

FF96.name: tasks_mode6
doc: Mode 6: stage clear.

FFA6.name: tasks_mode7
doc: Mode 7: challenging stage.

FFC0.name: tasks_mode8
doc: Mode 8: challenging stage results.

FFCA.name: tasks_mode9
doc: Mode 9: high score check and name entry.

AFBE.name: task_hiscore_entry
doc: Mode 9 task: high score entry, sub-state $11FF through
hiscore_steps (0 check, 1 draw screen, 2 enter name).

AFCD.name: hiscore_draw_screen
doc: Mode 9 step 1: draw the TOP 5 screen (dat_B070 titles, table, the placeholder row at the new rank), entry_timer = 5, hiscore_step 2.

B304.name: hiscore_enter_name
doc: Mode 9 step 2, once a frame: the stick cycles the character under entry_cursor through its field's alphabet (8-frame repeat, entry_repeat), fire accepts, entry_timer runs; finishing stores the table and returns to mode 5 via after_name_entry_p1/_p2.
QUIRK: the alphabet wrap reads the byte 2 before each alphabet ($B416, $B435, $B443): the index of its terminator.

B49F.name: hiscore_check
doc: Compare the player's score (tile digits) with the five table
entries at $0900 (16 bytes each), shift the lower entries down and
insert; pick the rank music (sound 3 for 1st, 4 otherwise).
QUIRK: rank 5 leaves entry_rank untouched; main_task += 2 skips task_game_over_check.

B656.name: load_formation_sprites
doc: Copy the formation's sprite codes: dat_B6BA[$106E] points at 9 words, the first 8 fill runs of shadow words at $0E02-$0E83, the 9th goes to $0E84.

B6F6.name: service_mode
doc: Service / test mode (DSW service switch, checked at boot and in every IRQ). Re-initialises like reset, then: RAM test $0000-$1FFF and $6040-$63FF with rotating patterns (15 passes, see svc_ram_test), custom-chip check, ROM checksums of $A000/$C000/$E000 (error digit 1-3 at tile $0306), sub/sound handshake and their checksum results, then the DIP settings and the sound test. Leaving the switch resets through reset_main.
BUG: the sound-RAM and custom-chip error codes are loaded into B but A = $20 is stored: they show as blanks and pass the "OK" check at $B926.

B77C.name: fill_tilemap_00_20
doc: Fill $0000-$03FF with $00,$20 word pairs.

BA2F.name: print_string
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at X to tile address U going
right (U -= $20 per character). Returns X past the terminator.

BD7B.name: service_loop
doc: Service mode loop: the service coin starts the cross hatch, which stays until the service coin is pressed AGAIN ($BD8A waits for bit 3 of $6800 to come back); service switch off -> reset_main; a change of switch nibbles 0-2 steps the sound test ($100A) and plays it, nibble 3 only plays it.
QUIRK: the cross hatch needs a second press of the service coin to end.

BE01.name: draw_test_grid
doc: Draw the cross-hatch test pattern over the tilemap $0000-$03FF (codes only).

BE37.name: easter_egg
doc: Hidden screen in the service mode: shown when the sound test is on
$09 with the stick up-left, or on $19 with the stick left, while
start 1 + P1 fire are held (56XX mode 1: $6801 stick, $6803 = 5).
Draws the bitmap at $BE78 as '0' tiles and hangs.
QUIRK: hangs for good (watchdog kicked).

BFEF.name: checksum_A000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $A000-$BFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

DFFF.name: checksum_C000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $C000-$DFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

FFEF.name: checksum_E000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $E000-$FFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

FA7D.name: task_bonus_life
doc: Extra ship check: compare the current player's score with the bonus
settings ($1001-$1003) through bonus_steps ($1124 P1 / $1125 P2).

EAA4.name: task_stage_events
doc: Mode 1 task: on the stages listed at $EACC run the stage event
steps (index $116E).

D676.name: task_stage_clear
doc: Mode 6: stage cleared. Reset the formation flags and enemy sprites,
silence, next stage for the current player, stage-clear sound 5
(sound 2 on the stages listed at $D6E8), back to mode 0.

D915.name: task_player_hit_check
doc: Build a box around the player ($10C6-$10C9) and test the sprite
shadow entries $0ECE-$0F13 against it (enemy shots and enemies).
QUIRK: game over waits exactly 256 frames; a player with 0 lives gets $FF reserve markers capped to 4.

B73C.name: svc_ram_test
doc: 15 passes, not 16: D enters as $000B (left by the 62XX init
INCBs), so the offsets are $000B, $111C, ... $EEF9.

C909.name: logo_anim_start
doc: Title logo step 0: sprite entry 10 ($1614) at $7420, flags $4080; logo_anim_step + 1; then logo_anim_colours.

C91B.name: logo_anim_rise
doc: Title logo step 1: move entry 10 up; at $FF place entries 10-14 at $74FF and step logo_anim_step. Then logo_anim_colours.

C952.name: logo_anim_spread
doc: Title logo step 2: spread entries 10-14 apart until $161C reaches $A8, then set up entries 15/16 and step logo_anim_step. Then logo_anim_colours.

C9AE.name: logo_anim_colours
doc: Every title pass: colours of entries 10-14 from dat_CA36[frame_counter & $1E]; jumps back to attract_loop.

CDA1.name: start_turn
doc: Start of a turn (second half of start_game_1p, also from $DB8E): starfield, player speeds, shot slots end, start tune while the reserve ships fly in (CWAI per frame), then task_dispatch_sync.

D029.name: demo_end
doc: End of the demo (also from $E3F8): attract timer = $E0/$FF, clear sprites, sounds, schedulers and game_mode, jump to attract_loop (the stack is abandoned).

D223.name: task_dual_shots
doc: With the dual fighter: copy each active shot of slots $0EA2/$0EA4 fighter_count times from $0EAA up, the n-th Y offset by dat_D283[n] (signed).

D8B0.name: task_sound_queue
doc: Unless player_dying: pass the sound requests queued in $0840-$087F to snd_request (1 each, queue cleared); while dying clear every request except sounds $14 and $16.

D8F8.name: task_formation_offset
doc: fighter_offsets ($10DD/$10DE) = the word dat_D907[fighter_count] (formation offsets for the number of fighters; LDD A,X signed).

D28A.name: task_shot_hits
doc: The player's shots against enemies and objects: build a hitbox per active shot ($10C6-$10CA) and test the formation, the diving enemies and the objects $0EE2-$0F12; hits go to enemy_hit.
QUIRK: shots_to_clear is stored, not OR-ed; boss_bonus_idx runs past boss_bonus_sprites into code; the formation scan ends only at X = formation_end.

D431.name: enemy_hit
doc: Enemy at U hit: count it (effect_request), note its position (effect_pos) and type ($110B); with $1102 & $1075 put a score sprite ($4F) in a free slot of $0ECE-$0EDA with a speed from dat_D4B6/D4E0/D50A. In: U = the enemy's position entry.

D588.name: task_formation_count
doc: Mode 5 formation bookkeeping: count free/moving slots ($1860-$188B) into several flags ($1020, $10F8, $1122, $1075); when the stage is empty count clear_delay and move to the next mode.

D9CF.name: fighter_reset_lose_life
doc: From $F8D2 (end of the explosion): reset the fighter (speeds, no dual fighter, shots $0EA2-$0EA9, $1100/$1101), then lose_life.

DA87.name: game_over_to_attract
doc: End of a game (from $FC7D/$FC9F): clear the game RAM and sprites, wait a frame, back to attract_loop.
QUIRK: clears $102A-$11FF (frame_sync, main_task included) but only the low two bytes of each score.

DBE2.name: after_name_entry_p1
doc: After player 1's high-score entry (from $B301): continue the game-over flow for player 1.

DC0B.name: after_name_entry_p2
doc: After player 2's high-score entry (from $B2F6): continue the game-over flow for player 2.

DC1C.name: print_string_attr_r
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at U from tile X going right (X -= $20 per char), attribute B for each. Out: X, U past the end.

DEC1.name: count_game_time
doc: If player 1 played at least a second, add one (BCD) to the stats counter $09D6+i for his play time in minutes (i = 0-10: 0..6, 7-9, 10-14, 15-24, 25+ min); then clear p1_time.
QUIRK: 25+ minutes count into $09E0, past stats_counters.

E22F.name: results_draw
doc: Results step 0: reset the counters, results_hits_left = results_count, print EARNINGS / 100 X / 200 X / TOTAL; when results_delay wraps go to step 1 with the player's bonus kind in results_bonus_kind.

E29A.name: results_count_hits
doc: Results step 1: every other frame count one hit (results_count down; sound $17, results_count_one draws it); last hit sound $0A; below 0 -> step 2.

E2D0.name: results_markers
doc: Results step 2: draw the remaining hit markers (tile $60) of the bonus kind's pattern, print the bonus line (results_bonus_line), step 3; no bonus line -> results_no_bonus.

E346.name: results_show_bonus
doc: Results step 3: show the bonus line until results_timer wraps (then step 4); kinds 1 and 4 wait for fire (sound 8) and cycle a digit at $017A; the line blinks every 4th frame.

E3AD.name: results_payout
doc: Results step 4: with results_timer = 0 pay out the bonus by kind (tbl_E65F), else count results_timer up.

E332.name: results_no_bonus
doc: Results step 5: wait until results_delay wraps, then results_timer = $FF and pay out the total.

E3FF.name: results_count_one
doc: Count one hit: blank its marker; below tile $1000 a 100-point hit (results_hits100, earnings + 1), else a 200-point hit (earnings + 2, results_hits200); BCD, redraws the digits.

E4DA.name: results_bonus_line
doc: Print the bonus line of kind results_bonus_kind & 7 through tbl_E4E5 (JMP [A,X]; the entry's RTS returns to the caller).

E6C8.name: add_score_times
doc: add_score(1) (10 points) results_count times.

E7A6.name: payout_lucky
doc: Kind 5 pay-out: move the component sprite up a step a frame (sound 6) to its place, copy it to entry $0F28 (or $0F26) and park it.

E811.name: payout_byebye
doc: Kind 6 pay-out: count the dropped component's timer down (sound 6), then clear its flag.

E83B.name: payout_extend
doc: Kind 7 pay-out: one more life for the current player (flag_extra_ship redraws the reserve; sound $15).

EA21.name: task_challenge_marks
doc: Mode 7 task: the player's challenging pattern (bonus_kind_p1/p2) into results_bonus_kind; draw results_count (max $A5) marks of that pattern (mark_patterns).

EA89.name: task_clear_parked_flags
doc: Modes 0-6 task: for the 37 shadow entries $16CE-$1716 parked at Y >= $E0 clear the flag byte at +$0801.

EB01.name: task_next
doc: INC <main_task / JMP task_dispatch: common end of the event steps (and tbl_EB82 step 8).

EB5B.name: stage_events_reset
doc: Clear event_step, event_timer and $107A... ($107C) and jump to task_dispatch without advancing the task (also tbl_EABA steps 3-8, never reached).

EB66.name: task_stage_events_play
doc: Mode 5 task: when $1010 is $10 set the starfield for it (star_dir_flags = 1); otherwise on the stages listed at dat_EB94 run event step event_step (tbl_EB82).

EAD5.name: stage_event1_step0
doc: Mode-1 event step 0: sound 24 every frame; at frame $3C star_dir_flags = 2 (0 flipped), starfield $87/$87, next step.

EB06.name: stage_event1_step1
doc: Mode-1 event step 1: at frame $78 starfield $80/$80 ($86/$86 flipped), next step.

EB2B.name: stage_event1_step2
doc: Mode-1 event step 2: at frame $B4 starfield $81/$82 ($86/$85 flipped), frame_counter = 7, wait a frame, next game mode.

F6DD.name: task_player_explosion
doc: While player_exploding: $80 to $112A and $101A, and every 8th frame one step of tbl_F6FC (explosion_step); the last step ends in fighter_reset_lose_life.

F70C.name: explosion_start
doc: Explosion step 0: explosion sprite at $0F32 centred on the player; the player's sprite and state cleared, the six dual-fighter flags $1EC3-$1ECD cleared.

F824.name: explosion_end
doc: Explosion step 7: count $0F30 up to 0; then (not in mode 4) reset the player's sprite and captured ships, ready timers = $FF in mode 5, and jump to fighter_reset_lose_life.

F8DA.name: task_cycle_colours
doc: Every 4th frame move the 16 shadow codes $0EA2-$0EC0 one code down/up (decided by the first); the seven shots $0ECE-$0EDA with code >= $4F get the blink code dat_F91D.

F921.name: task_shot_collisions
doc: JMP $F9D5: unless $101A, test the six captured ships $0EC2-$0ECC against the seven enemy shots $0ECE-$0EDA; the first hit spawns an effect, frees the shot, sound $0B, and removes the ship.
QUIRK: only one hit a frame. $F924-$F9CF is skipped (dead code).

F6C5.name: effect_free_slot
doc: Effect step 33: free the slot that owns U ($0E8C -> $110C, $0E8E -> $110D, else $110E).

FA94.name: bonus_first_p1
doc: Bonus life step 0 of P1: score_p1+1 (BCD x 10,000) >= bonus_first.

FAAB.name: bonus_second_p1
doc: Bonus life step 1 of P1: the second threshold.

FADB.name: bonus_every_p1
doc: Bonus life step 2 of P1: every bonus_every after that (next_bonus_p1).

FB25.name: bonus_first_p2
doc: Bonus life step 0 of P2.

FB3B.name: bonus_second_p2
doc: Bonus life step 1 of P2 (see the BUG at $FB65).

FB6A.name: bonus_every_p2
doc: Bonus life step 2 of P2.

FB0F.name: bonus_task_end
doc: INC <main_task / JMP task_dispatch: end of every task in $FA7D-$FB9D; also step 3 of both tables (no more bonuses).

FB9E.name: flag_extra_ship
doc: Flag an extra reserve ship: the first of $1F17/$1F19/$1F1B with bit 7 clear gets $81.

FBB1.name: task_ready_timer
doc: Modes 3, 5, 7: on frames with frame_counter & 7 != 0 count the player's ready timer down (ready_timer_p1/p2 via ready_timer); at $60 blank the message line, at $D0 print READY; ready_active while counting.

FC1F.name: print_msg_line
doc: Print 12 characters from X at tile $02B2 going right, attribute 0.

FC33.name: task_game_over_check
doc: Modes 5 and 9: when no player has lives and no credit/start is pending, wait for the sub CPU (sub_task 0 or $1B), in mode 9 copy the TOP 5 from the screen to hiscore_table/names, then game_over_to_attract.

FE18.name: task_bonus_ship
doc: Mode 5: with one formation slot left and the slot (stage + score_p1) & $1F occupied, put the bonus ship in shadow $0F14 (sound $19); a player touching it wins a ship (sound $15).

BE15.name: grid_row_pair
doc: One row pair of the cross hatch: 16 x $6564 then 16 x $6766 from U up (tiles $64-$67).

BE1D.name: store_x_16
doc: Store the word X 16 times from U up (STX ,U++); U returned past the run.

E20A.name: fill_32_blank
doc: Store $2020 at U++ 32 times (two fill_16_words).

E4F5.name: line_bonus
doc: Bonus kind 0: "BONUS" COMPLETED / BONUS POINTS 10000.

E50C.name: line_gaplus
doc: Kinds 1 and 4: "GAPLUS" (kind 4 " GOOD ") COMPLETED / BONUS POINTS 00000 / PUSH FIRING BUTTON.

E53A.name: line_double
doc: Kind 2: "DOUBLE" COMPLETED; the bonus is the earnings again (digits copied to $013A-$017A).

E563.name: line_triple
doc: Kind 3: "TRIPLE" COMPLETED; the bonus is twice the earnings, doubled digit by digit in BCD.

E5F3.name: line_lucky
doc: Kind 5: "LUCKY" COMPLETED / ONE COMPONENT ADDED, and a component sprite in shadow entry $0F2C.

E626.name: line_byebye
doc: Kind 6: "BYEBYE" COMPLETED / ONE COMPONENT DROPPED.

E63D.name: line_extend
doc: Kind 7: "EXTEND" COMPLETED / YOU GET A SHIP.

E66F.name: payout_bonus
doc: Kind 0 pay-out: grand total = earnings + 10000, then the common pay-out ($E68E).

E6D6.name: payout_gaplus
doc: Kinds 1 and 4 pay-out: grand total = earnings with the button digit ($017A & 7) added to the hundreds.

E6FC.name: payout_double
doc: Kind 2 pay-out: grand total = earnings + bonus.

E77A.name: payout_triple
doc: Kind 3 pay-out, the same as payout_double.

EB9B.name: stage_event5_step0
doc: Mode-5 event step 0: star_dir_flags = 1, sound 24, next step.

EBA9.name: stage_event5_step1
doc: Mode-5 event step 1: at frame $32 starfield $87/$86 ($87/$80 flipped).

EBD5.name: stage_event5_step2
doc: Mode-5 event step 2: at frame $64 starfield register 2 = $87.

EBEC.name: stage_event5_step3
doc: Mode-5 event step 3: at frame $96 starfield register 2 = $80 ($86 flipped).

EC0E.name: stage_event5_step4
doc: Mode-5 event step 4: at frame $C8 starfield $80/$81 ($86/$85 flipped).

EC3A.name: stage_event5_step5
doc: Mode-5 event step 5: at frame $FA star_dir_flags = 2 and starfield $81/$82 (flipped: 0, $85/$84), event_timer = 0.

EC71.name: stage_event5_step6
doc: Mode-5 event step 6: wait until event_timer wraps (256 frames), next step.

EC7E.name: stage_event5_step7
doc: Mode-5 event step 7: the same 256-frame wait.

F673.name: effect_exit
doc: effect_steps[0] (step $80 only): BRA $F5F5 -- does the calling task's INC <main_task / JMP task_dispatch from inside the JSR.
QUIRK: leaves the task from inside a JSR; the return address stays on the stack until the next LDS.

F675.name: effect_start
doc: Effect step 1: sprite code/colour $68,$32 at ,U.

F67B.name: effect_colour
doc: Most effect steps: INC 1,U (the colour byte).

F67E.name: effect_step9
doc: Effect step 9: code/colour $69,$32 at ,U.

F684.name: effect_grow
doc: Effect step 17: code $60,$32, then double size: Y -= 8, X -= 8 (+8 flipped) with the carry into the X high bit, flags $68.

F6BA.name: effect_step24
doc: Effect step 24: code/colour $64,$32 at ,U.

F6C0.name: effect_hide
doc: Effect step 32: CLR $1001,U -- the sprite is no longer in use.

F76D.name: explosion_grow
doc: Explosion step 1: (special case in mode 5 for a captured ship) then the explosion grows to two sprites ($0F30/$0F32, 16 pixels apart).

F7DA.name: explosion_step2
doc: Explosion step 2: codes $CE/$DE.

F7EA.name: explosion_step3
doc: Explosion step 3: codes $EE/$FE.

F7FA.name: explosion_step4
doc: Explosion step 4: back to one sprite, code $58,$27 at $0F32, flags $68.

F80E.name: explosion_step5
doc: Explosion step 5: code $5C at $0F32.

F819.name: explosion_step6
doc: Explosion step 6: $F8 at $0F30 (a countdown to 0).

A000.name: mark_patterns
doc: Challenging-stage mark patterns: 8 pointers to lists of tile addresses (>= $1000: other bank); also the start of the ROM checksum.

AADA.name: demo_script_1
doc: Demo input script (stage 1 demo): bytes = stick << 1 | fire, each held for the duration byte $100 further on; $F0 ends the demo.

ACBC.name: demo_script_2
doc: Demo input script of the stage-2 (challenging) demo, same format as demo_script_1.

B070.name: hiscore_screen_text
doc: TOP 5 screen: (tile address, string pointer) pairs, 0 ends.

B164.name: hiscore_staff_text
doc: Staff screen of the JNIWAR name: (tile address, string pointer) pairs, 0 ends.

B155.name: str_jniwar
doc: The secret name "JNIWAR  28  OO" compared by hiscore_enter_name.

B418.name: alphabet_letters
doc: Name-entry alphabet of the name field; the byte 2 before it is its terminator index.

B437.name: alphabet_digits
doc: Name-entry alphabet of the age field.

B445.name: alphabet_blood
doc: Name-entry alphabet of the blood-type field ("ABO ?").

B6BA.name: formation_sprite_ptrs
doc: load_formation_sprites: pointers by $106E to 9 sprite-code words.

CA36.name: logo_colours
doc: Title logo code/colour words by frame_counter & $1E.

CF41.name: player_limits
doc: player_xmin / player_xmax pairs by fighter_count.

D283.name: dual_shot_offsets
doc: Y offsets of the dual-fighter shot copies (signed).

D3A1.name: boss_bonus_sprites
doc: Code/colour words of the boss bonus sprite by boss_bonus_idx (no end marker).

D907.name: fighter_offset_table
doc: fighter_offsets words by fighter_count.

EA11.name: button_digits_good
doc: Digit cycle of the " GOOD " bonus (kind 4).

EA19.name: button_digits_gaplus
doc: Digit cycle of the "GAPLUS" bonus (kind 1).

EB94.name: event_stages
doc: Stages with mode-5 starfield events.

EE84.name: stage_attack_counts
doc: load_stage_params: 4 bytes per record to $1036-$1039 (moving-slot counts for task_attack_timer).

EEA4.name: stage_trio_thresholds
doc: load_stage_params: 8 bytes per record to $103A-$1041 (trio launch timer thresholds).

EEC4.name: stage_group_thresholds
doc: load_stage_params: 8 bytes per record to $1042-$1049 and $104A-$1051 (group launch thresholds).

EFC4.name: stage_shot_limit
doc: load_stage_params: words to $1064 (end of the enemy shot slots).

F266.name: stage_dive_paths
doc: load_stage_params: 8 records of 4 path pointers to $1052-$1059 (the dive paths, sub path_XXXX streams).

F486.name: stage_tables_by_difficulty
doc: load_stage_params: table pointers by difficulty ($1004), signed index.

F496.name: stage_speeds
doc: load_stage_params: bytes for $100F-$1011 (+1 at difficulty >= 5).

F91D.name: shot_blink_codes
doc: Blink codes of the enemy shots by (frame_counter & $0F) >> 2.
